messages.author: 6d3f7222550fe21b
messages.subject: legend.key.size no function "unit"
parts:
What is the proper way to control the size of the legend key? My attempt to use "unit" follows https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Legend-Attributes.

> junk<-data.frame(x=1:10, y=rnorm(10), waa=c(rep("a", 5), rep("b", 5)))
> library(ggplot2)
> ggplot(junk, aes(x,y, color=waa)) + geom_point()
> ggplot(junk, aes(x,y, color=waa)) + geom_point() + theme(legend.key.size=unit(5,"cm"))
